name: EvalRunSpec
description:
EvalRunSpec says what an eval run is about, whose cases run, on which
 models, how many times, and within what spend.

fields.name: AgentId
fields.description: ID of the agent the cases run on.

fields.name: PluginId
fields.description:
ID of a plugin whose own cases run on the built-in assistant, with
 the plugin and, unless ablation is none, without it.

fields.name: AgentVersion
fields.description:
The agent version to evaluate, a version hash or a tag. Empty
 evaluates the current version. Only with agent_id.

fields.name: PluginDigest
fields.description:
The version (archive digest) of the plugin evaluated. Empty evaluates
 its current version. Only with plugin_id.

fields.name: ComparedPluginId
fields.description:
ID of a plugin each case runs with and, unless ablation is none,
 without, on the agent: whether the agent does better with it. The
 agent may attach it or not. Only with agent_id.

fields.name: Cases
fields.description:
Whose cases run, on an agent: Evals of the agent's organization, and
 plugins the agent attaches or the compared plugin. Empty runs the
 compared plugin's cases when one is named, else the cases of every
 plugin the agent attaches. Only with agent_id; an eval run of a plugin
 runs that plugin's own cases.

fields.name: Targets
fields.description:
The engines and models each case runs on, at most six. Empty runs each
 case on the agent as it runs (its own engine, model and settings), or,
 on the built-in assistant, on the model the case names or the
 platform's default model.

fields.name: Runs
fields.description:
Tries per case, arm and target, from 1 to 50. Zero uses each case's
 own runs value, or 3.

fields.name: Ablation
fields.description:
Whether each case also runs without the compared plugin. Ignored when
 no plugin is compared: an agent's own cases run with what it
 attaches.

fields.name: Threshold
fields.description:
The score a case needs to pass, from 0 to 1, or 1 when unset: every
 scored check passes on every try.

fields.name: CaseGlob
fields.description:
Runs only the cases whose directory name matches this glob, as in
 "review-*". Empty runs every case.

fields.name: CaseTags
fields.description:
Runs only the cases carrying at least one of these tags. Empty runs
 every case.

fields.name: JudgeModel
fields.description:
The model AI-graded checks use. Empty uses the platform's default
 judge model.

fields.name: MaxCostUsd
fields.description:
The most this eval run may spend, in estimated US dollars of model
 cost.

 Checked before each try starts, counting what tries already spent and
 the cap each running try still holds: tries already running and their
 AI-graded checks finish, so the spend can pass the limit by those.

fields.name: Concurrency
fields.description: Tries running at once, from 1 to 8. Zero means 1.

fields.name: AllowTools
fields.description:
Tools every try may use beyond each case's own list, in Claude Code's
 names, as Claude Code's --allow-tools.

 A try runs with only the tools its case and this list grant, within
 the agent's own tool lists: name the agent's working tools here (Skill
 for its skills, Agent for its hand-offs to subagents). A specifier in
 parentheses, as in Bash(npm test *), grants the whole tool. A plugin's
 MCP tools are named as Claude Code names them,
 mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>; the tools of a server written in
 the agent itself are mcp__<server>__<tool>.

fields.name: RealMcpServers
fields.description:
Runs the MCP servers for real, the agent's own and its plugins', with
 the organization's connections. Off by default: a try cannot call MCP
 tools no mock answers, as in Claude Code's evals without mocks.

fields.name: Vaults
fields.description:
Vaults whose logins and secrets the tries use, in order: the first
 vault holding a match wins. At most 20.

 A try has no person, so these vaults are all its hooks and servers
 use. Each is a shared vault: a My vault, the creator's included, is
 refused, because every viewer of the subject may read a try, and a
 hook's or server's output can show what a key unlocked.

fields.name: SkipScaffold
fields.description:
Skips each case's scaffold script, as Claude Code's --no-scaffold; a
 case that has one is then listed as not run.

 A scaffold runs in the try's own sandbox, as the agent, with none of
 the eval run's vaults, so no opt-in is asked for it.

fields.name: AllowRealServers
fields.description:
Starts the real MCP servers no mock answers, as Claude Code's
 --allow-real-servers; mocked tools still answer from their files.
 Their tools still need allow_tools.
